scripts.clean: npx --yes shx@0.4.0 rm -rf build && npx --yes shx@0.4.0 mkdir build
scripts.minify: npx --yes terser@5.50.0 game.js --compress passes=4,unsafe_math=true,unsafe_methods=true --mangle toplevel --format ascii_only=true,comments=false --output build/game.js
scripts.zip: cd build && npx --yes bestzip@3.0.2 uni-ark.zip index.html game.js && npx --yes --package advzip-bin@2.0.0 advzip --recompress --shrink-extra uni-ark.zip
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run minify && npm run copy && npm run zip && npm run check-size
